2609.04714.title: Refuse without Refusal: A Structural Analysis of Safety-Tuning Responses for Reducing False Refusals in Language Models
2609.04714.paper_summary: Striking a balance between helpfulness and safety remains a fundamental challenge in aligning large language models. To achieve this balance, models should refuse harmful queries (e.g., "How do I shoot someone?") while remaining responsive to benign inputs, even those superficially resembling harmful queries (e.g., "Where can I shoot a good photo?"). However, models often struggle to distinguish genuinely harmful queries from benign queries that contain superficially risky language, resulting in false refusals. In this paper, we address the issue by decomposing a response in the safety-tuning dataset into two distinct components: (i) a boilerplate refusal statement and (ii) a rationale explaining the refusal. Our experiments and analyses show that refusal statements impede accurate discrimination between harmful and benign queries by inducing reliance on superficial cues. In contrast, training solely on rationales reduces false refusals while maintaining a comparable level of safety performance. Rationale-Only benefits also appear in our ICL configuration and remain compatible with the evaluated inference-time mitigation methods. The results emphasize the necessity of precisely curated, fine-grained safety supervision datasets and outline directions for constructing aligned agents that better reconcile helpfulness with safety.
2609.04714.paper_summary_zh: 在大型語言模型的對齊中，平衡有用性和安全性仍然是一個基本挑戰。<lb/>為了實現這一平衡，模型應該拒絕有害的查詢（例如，“我該如何射擊某人？”），同時對無害的輸入保持回應，即使這些輸入在表面上看起來像是有害的查詢（例如，“我可以在哪裡拍攝好照片？”）。<lb/>然而，模型常常難以區分真正有害的查詢和包含表面上風險語言的無害查詢，導致錯誤拒絕。<lb/>在本文中，我們通過將安全調整數據集中的回應分解為兩個不同的組件來解決這一問題：（i）一個標準拒絕聲明和（ii）解釋拒絕的理由。<lb/>我們的實驗和分析顯示，拒絕聲明通過誘導對表面線索的依賴，妨礙了對有害查詢和無害查詢的準確區分。<lb/>相反，僅基於理由的訓練在保持相似的安全性能水平的同時，減少了錯誤拒絕。<lb/>理由僅的好處也出現在我們的ICL配置中，並與評估的推理時間減輕方法保持兼容。<lb/>結果強調了精心策劃的、細緻的安全監督數據集的必要性，並概述了構建更好地調和有用性與安全性的對齊代理的方向。
2609.04714.author: Minji Kim et.al.
